plugins.name: common
plugins.description: Shared building blocks: the auto-format PostToolUse hook, a SessionStart hook injecting baseline working rules, the unslop writing-cleanup skill, the code-comments skill, and the test-strategy skill.

plugins.name: toolkit
plugins.description: Cedric's personal layer on top of oss and skills: TDD hooks, hooks blocking fable-model subagents and forcing a fable session to delegate edits to a subagent, the GitHub issue/PR orchestration engine, code-review helpers, and SignalDB observability.

plugins.name: oss
plugins.description: Generic engineering practice, reusable in any repo: commit discipline, stacked PRs, writing tests, technical writing, no-comments, GitHub issue creation, release notes, and a scoped implementation agent. Depends on common.

plugins.name: skills
plugins.description: Generic tool-integration skills, reusable in any repo regardless of who you are: CodeRabbit reviews, the Forgejo CLI, and dashboard design/review. Depends on common and coderabbit.
